newsitem.title: FRANCE: Arthuis expects stability pact accord in Dublin.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis expects stability pact accord in Dublin.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Wednesday he expected European Union finance ministers to reach an agreement on a budget stability pact for EMU at a meeting in Dublin next week.
"We have advanced considerably," he said at a business conference.
EU finance ministers failed to agree on a stability pact at a meeting in Brussels on Monday but agreed to meet again in Dublin on the eve of an EU summit scheduled for December 13-14.
"If we agreed to meet it is to reach an accord on the stability pact," he said.
He repeated that France favoured such a pact to maintain budget discipline after the launch of the euro.

"I am having very close discussions on this point with other economy and finance ministers in the European Union and I hope that we will be able to reach a full agreement shortly. The creation of this pact will be a solid guarantee of the future credibility of the euro which is, I remind you, a condition for the lowest possible interest rates."
